Not full application startup, layout, scrolling or catalog navigation performance

aggregate_rendering.method: Equal-weight geometric mean of ratios of the eight median frame times; shaping excluded

validation.native_mask_reference: Packed vs unatlased Core Text; four transforms, all interpolation modes; maximum allowed channel error 1
validation.rectangle_reference: Exact native geometry pixels for integral/fractional bounds, four transforms, aliased and antialiased edges
validation.image_reference: 80 cases, two isolated groups each, general vs fast pipeline; maximum allowed channel error 1; includes canvas clipping and atlas neighbors
validation.shaping_reference: Exact glyph IDs, clusters, advances and offsets vs mutable native attributes; Latin/Arabic/Hebrew combining marks and full/contextual subranges
validation.background_load: User explicitly requested timing with background load recorded. Application basenames are redacted in this committed summary; raw samples/snapshots remain local.

macos_catalog.result: Captured both render paths for every selected page

before_after_validation_pixels.result: All eight untimed validation frames byte-identical, including all three native text scripts
before_after_validation_pixels.method: Separate two-trial capture-isolation regression run; short-run timing data excluded from reported performance

published_path_policy: Checkout-relative paths and ~/ home placeholders; recorded measurements and artifact/source hashes are unchanged.
privacy_history_policy: Personal paths, background process names and local device identifiers are omitted. Source commit IDs from the superseded branch are redacted; content hashes and measurements are historical and predate the upstream rebase.
